python3 -c "
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name='Budget', header=None)
df.columns = ['category', 'item', 'amount', 'notes']

# Expense rows are Excel rows 11-22 -> pandas index 10-21, amounts in column C (index 2)
exp = df.iloc[10:22][['category', 'item', 'amount']].dropna(subset=['amount']).copy()
exp['amount'] = pd.to_numeric(exp['amount'])

print('=== Expense breakdown ===')
print(exp.to_string(index=False))
print()
print('Per-category totals:')
print(exp.groupby('category')['amount'].sum().to_string())
print()
print('TOTAL EXPENSES =', exp['amount'].sum())
"

python3 -c "
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name='Budget', header=None)

# Expense rows: Excel rows 11-22 -> 0-based index 10-21
# col0 = category, col1 = item, col2 = amount
exp = df.iloc[10:22, [0, 1, 2]].copy()
exp.columns = ['category', 'item', 'amount']
exp = exp.dropna(subset=['amount'])
exp['amount'] = pd.to_numeric(exp['amount'])

print('=== Expense breakdown ===')
print(exp.to_string(index=False))
print()
print('Per-category totals:')
print(exp.groupby('category')['amount'].sum().to_string())
print()
print('TOTAL EXPENSES =', exp['amount'].sum())
"
